dominant_strengths: Tactile material contrast: woven canvas pouch against precision-milled aluminum TX-6 reads as honest, considered industrial craft
Restrained monochrome palette with single orange accent maintains TE's signature visual system across product and packaging
Modular pouch concept extends the field-mixer ethos into carry, reinforcing a coherent portable-studio narrative
dominant_weaknesses: Crop is brutal: hero product is decapitated at top edge, undermining the composition and product legibility
Vast empty lower two-thirds plus black footer band creates dead weight rather than purposeful negative space
Tiny 'explore offer' link is visually orphaned, lacking hierarchy connection to the truncated headline above
fix_priorities: Reframe the shot so the full TX-6 + pouch silhouette is visible with intentional headroom
Rebalance type block: anchor headline, CTA, and product to a shared grid instead of floating
Resolve the abrupt black band — either integrate as a deliberate footer or remove the seam
rationale.norman_balance: Strong reflective and visceral pull through material storytelling, but behavioral clarity suffers because the cropped hero and weak CTA hierarchy obscure the actual offer.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures TE's accessory-system language convincingly, but the layout execution undersells the product rather than amplifying it.
